barbell = a long bar with weights at each end, used for lifting
dumbbells = short bars with weights, held in each hand
treadmill = a machine with a moving belt that you run or walk on
harness = straps worn around the body and attached to a rope for safety
oar = a long pole with a blade, used to row a boat
ski poles = poles used for balance and push on skis
fixture = a scheduled match in a competition
tournament = a series of games that continue until there is a winner
championship = a competition to decide the best team or player in a sport
qualifying round = an early stage that decides who reaches the main competition
league = a group of clubs that play one another over a season
cup tie = a match in a knockout cup competition
quarter-final = a match whose winner reaches the last four
semi-final = a match whose winner goes through to the final
play-off = an extra match or series to decide promotion, qualification or a title
derby = a match between two clubs from the same city or region
friendly = a match that does not count in a league or cup
extra time = additional playing time when a knockout match is still a draw
penalty shoot-out = taking turns at penalties to decide a drawn knockout match
Olympic Games = the world's largest multi-sport event, held every four years
